items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: We pinch hitted one time for the great team of Tip, Tap and Toe, see, on a Duke Ellington itinerary, which was a chartered tour here in the United States.

ctx.x: Oh, my goodness. Well, if there's been some people writing songs, they all come by Duke Ellington especially. He composed a song, him and one of his colleagues, they composed a song called, "Breaking in A Pair of Shoes". And he gave that to Chuck and Chuckles as a present, you see. We pinch hitted one time for the great team of Tip, Tap and Toe, see, on a Duke Ellington itinerary, which was a chartered tour here in the United States.
